julia_python_comparison.scope: Continuous norms only; no matching of timings, array layout or roundoff bit patterns.

python_supplied_replay_comparison.scope: Continuous norms only; no matching of timings, array layout or roundoff bit patterns.

performance.rss_scope: Whole benchmark namespace, including warmup/JIT; sampled sum, shared pages can be counted more than once. Not per-case RSS or an enforced aggregate cap. Outer launcher ru_maxrss is not used as Julia peak memory.

figures.runtime_bars: minimum–maximum of five actual repeats, not confidence intervals

scientific_source_freeze: Implementation, tests, benchmark source and admitted inputs unchanged after timing admission.
limitations: GR-01–06 proofs remain proposed for AUD-02; no Lean certification of these arguments.
Forced 1D manufactured solutions only; no 2D, general PDE regularity or novelty claim.
Uniform/nondecreasing-step Float64 meshes; extreme unrepresentable nodes or orders are outside the tested numerical range.
Finite-grid rates are observations, including nonmonotone uniform singular errors.
Controls retain diagnostic state/increment copies and use their actual high-precision library weight construction; timings/storage are implementation-specific.
Per-process and sampled execution safeguards are not aggregate cgroup isolation.
